'''Lobster Head''' was a weak and wimpy [[Lobster/Legends|lobster]]-headed [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who enjoyed a powerful [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] known as [[Lum/Legends|lum]].<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'' is implied to take place not long after the events of {{Film|IV}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> [[Gender/Legends|he]]<ref name="Classic Adventures" /> encountered a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" /> Already drunk,<ref name="Classic Adventures" /> he challenged one of them to a [[lumguzzling]] contest.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lobster Head first appeared in ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'', a [[1988]] adventure for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The outcome of Lobster Head's lumguzzling contest with the player character is determined by chance. If the game master controlling the alien should roll poorly, Lobster Head falls [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]].<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" />
